newsitem.title: JAPAN: Idemitsu starts 20,000 bpd advanced desulphuriser.
newsitem.headline: Idemitsu starts 20,000 bpd advanced desulphuriser.

text.p: Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd said on Friday it started commercial operation of a 20,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) advanced gas oil desulphurisation unit at its Tokuyama refinery in southern Japan.

With the new hydrodesulphurisation unit now on line, all of Idemitsu's five refineries in Japan have been equipped with desulphurisers, which lower the sulphur content of gas oil to less than 0.05 percent, Idemitsu said in a statement.
In October 1997 the government plans to implement stricter environmental standards on gas oil that will cut the maximum allowable sulphur content to 0.05 percent from 0.2 percent.
Idemitsu has spent 37 billion yen on building advanced desulphurising units at its five refineries, the statement said.
